versions.content: Role of meta-class DiagnosticParameter The role of the DiagnosticParameter is to allocate a well-defined (i.e. start, length, content) slot in a diagnostic telegram, represented e.g. by a DiagnosticDataIdentifier or DiagnosticRoutineSubfunction .
